title: Add plural resource quest_count_active
description: Add the plural resource used to localize the widget header's active-quest count ("%1$d quest active" / "%1$d quests active").
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains a <plurals name="quest_count_active"> with "one" item "%1$d quest active" and "other" item "%1$d quests active"
exact_code:
<plurals name="quest_count_active">
        <item quantity="one">%1$d quest active</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$d quests active</item>
    </plurals>
